inputText: This is Final Kaf — KAHF so-FEET. Sound: same sounds as Kaf, used only at the end of a word. Shape hook: long-necked hook with a straight drop. Tip: A rounded shoulder and long descending leg; final Nun lacks that broad hooked shoulder; do not mix it up with Final Nun, Resh.
